_shape: MENU / prompt-driven tool that reads stdin instead of argv (no --help). Feed keystrokes with printf and \n; assert on the OUTPUT, and set expect_exit to whatever the tool returns when its input loop hits EOF (often nonzero), not 0.

checks.name: menu-launch-show-ip
checks.expect_regex: IP Tracker.*Show Your IP|Your IP Adrress

note:
GhostTrack menu: 1=IP 2=ShowIP 3=Phone 4=Username 0=Exit. T0 feeds '2

0
' (Show-IP then Exit -> clean exit 0); T2 feeds '1
8.8.8.8
' (IP-track, then EOF -> exit 1 while the geo output above it is correct). The same stdin technique smoke-tests any prompt-driven tool (emploleaks, SatIntel, CardPwn): pipe the shortest sequence that exercises one real action, assert on output, expect the EOF exit code.
